subject: MAP: Nimbus Health evaluation materials — access roadmap and usage rules
messages:
From: Dr. Sarah Benson <sbenson@nimbushealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial MAP request — evaluation datasets & prompt pack access

Diego —

Thanks for the conversation earlier this week. Nimbus is keen to run a 6-week eval of Redwood inference for our clinical summarization flow. To move quickly we need a short mutual action plan that covers: delivery timeline for our test cases and prompt packs, access scope for Redwood-hosted sandbox, retention/destruction schedule, and audit evidence (access logs) for SOC-type review.

High-level asks from our side:
- We will provide de-identified clinical transcripts and 200 seed test cases (CSV).
- We need a secure ephemeral sandbox where data is kept for 90 days and then purged; audit logs retained for 180 days.
- No redistribution of our prompt packs or datasets outside of the Redwood evaluation project.
- A simple checklist we can circulate to procurement/legal for PO and data transfer approvals.

Can you propose a MAP and confirm who on your team will own the asset exchange and constraints? Ideally we can get files transferred and a signed minimal MPA by next week.

Best,
Sarah
Dr. Sarah Benson
Director of Clinical Informatics
Nimbus Health

Attachments: none
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Sarah Benson <sbenson@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial MAP request — evaluation datasets & prompt pack access

Sarah — thanks for laying this out so clearly. Principals on our side: Marissa (evaluation onboarding and asset ops) will coordinate the file transfer and retention mechanics; Karthik will own security/compliance point and the audit-log delivery. I will run the MAP with you and procurement until we reach a PO.

Quick responses to your asks:
- Redwood can host a sandbox with ephemeral containers and a dedicated ingestion pipeline. We typically support 90-day data retention with a 30-day grace period; we can discuss 120 days if Nimbus requires it.
- Audit logs: we can provide per-request traces (timestamps, model variant, token counts) for the evaluation period; standard retention is 180 days.
- Redistribution: we will include a non-distribution clause in the MPA and include a narrow eval-only license for the prompt packs/test cases.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa will send the Redwood MPA template and an asset delivery checklist (customer fills and returns).
2) Nimbus to confirm preferred transfer method (SFTP or secure Drive link) and contact for procurement.
3) We attach the MAP and a short operations SLA (sandbox uptime and expected turnaround for imports).

Can Marissa follow up with the template and the file stubs? Karthik, please flag any compliance carve-outs we should preempt.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Sarah Benson <sbenson@nimbushealth.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial MAP request — evaluation datasets & prompt pack access

Hi Sarah / Diego —

Attaching the Redwood MPA template, the delivery checklist, and a starter prompt pack we use for masked clinical summarization tests. Please review the usage constraints called out in Section 2 (locking, non-redistribution, ephemeral sandbox-only) — those reflect our standard eval terms but we can tighten the retention windows to align with Nimbus's compliance needs.

Files attached (stubs):
- nimbus_promptpack_v2.zip (zip, ~14 MB) — contains sanitized prompt examples and a README.
- nimbus_testcases_seed.tar.gz (tar.gz, ~6 MB) — 200 seed test cases, CSV + gold labels.
- MAP_timeline_v1.xlsx (xlsx) — proposed milestones and responsibilities.

Summary of key operation points (short):
- Access: SFTP link with short-lived credentials; token-based role access limited to a small set of hostnames.
- Retention: default 90 days on files in sandbox; retention extension to 120 days requires an approved MPA amendment and incremental logging retention fee (we've noted how that shows on the MAP timeline).
- Audit evidence: We will provide per-request access logs and a CSV export of activity; for deeper audit (IDS/packet-level) we will coordinate with your security contact and our SOC team.
- Destruction: secure wipe and revocation report once retention period ends.

Operational ask for Nimbus: confirm SFTP vs. secure Drive, provide procurement contact, and confirm whether you want the 90-day default or to request 120 days (we've called out both paths in the attached MAP timeline).

If everything looks good I will upload the files to an SFTP workspace and share credentials directly to your security mailbox (procurement only will get the PO instructions).

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Program Manager, Evaluation Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: nimbus_promptpack_v2.zip, nimbus_testcases_seed.tar.gz, MAP_timeline_v1.xlsx
From: Dr. Sarah Benson <sbenson@nimbushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 15:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial MAP request — evaluation datasets & prompt pack access

Marissa / Diego —

Thanks — the materials look good. A couple quick clarifications before we route to procurement:
- Nimbus prefers SFTP (scoped account) to Drive. Please proceed with SFTP credentialing.
- We will ask procurement to approve a 120-day retention window; they expect a short note on incremental logging costs. Can you update the MAP timeline to indicate the approval path and the estimated incremental fee?
- For audit evidence: the per-request CSV export is fine. For our SOC review we may request a one-time export of the activity log; please confirm Redwood can produce that on request.

If you can make the two small updates (SFTP plan + cost note for 120 days) we will circulate the MPA to legal/procurement and aim to signed PO in two weeks.

Appreciate the quick turnaround —
Sarah

Attachments: none
